capabilities: Sync notes and attachments to a Supabase project in real time
Merge simultaneous edits to one note with live cursors and presence badges
Save conflict copies when two devices edit the same note offline
Keep and restore up to 50 versions per note
Sync themes, snippets, hotkeys and plugins with per-device-type exceptions
disambiguation: Not a Supabase database browser or SQL client; it syncs vault files and settings to a Supabase project.
extras: Unofficial sync; database setup runs from a personal access token or by pasting the copied SQL into the Supabase SQL editor. The free Supabase plan is enough, and self-hosting instructions live in a separate guide.
intentEvidence: this is an unofficial way to sync and back up your notes. Obsidian Sync is the official option.
problem: Keeping a vault in sync across devices needs a paid service or manual copying, and Obsidian cannot merge edits made to the same note on two devices at once.

summary: Syncs a vault to a user's own Supabase project in real time, with live co-editing, version history, attachment storage and settings sync.
